## What's New in v1.6.3 — Nested Expandable Sub-Folders & Category Vaults

### 🗂️ Clean Sub-Folder Category Organization
- **Expandable Sub-Folder Vaults:** Grouped 100% of all features into nested category vaults (`ExpandableCategoryCard`) featuring circular accent icons, item subtitles, and smooth chevron rotation.
- **Privacy Vaults:** Divided into *Stealth & Read Receipts*, *Typing & Presence Cloak*, *Anti-Delete & Revoke Vault*, and *Call Protection & Info*.
- **General Vaults:** Divided into *Home Screen Toolbar & Header*, *Chat & Message Modifiers*, and *Status Stories & Channels*.
- **Style Vaults:** Divided into *Theme & Palette Customization*, *Home Layout & Instagram Stories*, and *Animations & Iconography*.
